# DRX Cleaning Company

> Professional carpet, upholstery, mattress and commercial cleaning company based in Orlando, Florida.
> Licensed, insured, eco-friendly products, satisfaction guaranteed.
> Serving Orlando and all of Central Florida — same-day appointments available.
> Phone: (321) 315-8595 | Email: info@drxcleaning.com

---

## About the Company

DRX Cleaning Company is a local, family-owned professional cleaning business serving homeowners
and businesses across Orlando, FL and the greater Central Florida area. The company uses
hospital-grade steam extraction equipment and 100% eco-safe, non-toxic products that are safe
for children, pets, and allergy-sensitive individuals.

All technicians are background-checked, trained, and certified. Every job is backed by a
100% satisfaction guarantee — if the client is not happy, DRX returns and re-cleans for free.

**Founded:** 2024
**Location:** Orlando, Florida, USA
**Service area:** Orlando, Windermere, Lake Nona, Dr. Phillips, Kissimmee, Oviedo, Winter Park,
Altamonte Springs, Sanford, Clermont, Celebration and surrounding Central Florida communities.

---

## Services Offered

- **Carpet Cleaning** — Hot-water extraction removes allergens, bacteria, pet stains and deep dirt.
  Dry time: 2–4 hours.
- **Stain Removal** — Professional pre-treatment for wine, coffee, pet urine, grease, ink and
  other tough stains.
- **Upholstery & Sofa Cleaning** — Fabric-safe deep cleaning for sofas, sectionals, recliners
  and dining chairs. Deodorizing included.
- **Deep Cleaning** — Full steam extraction with UV light sanitization. Eliminates 99% of
  bacteria, dust mites and hidden allergens.
- **Mattress Sanitization** — UV treatment + deep extraction removes sweat stains, dust mites
  and biological contaminants.
- **Commercial Cleaning** — Office buildings, retail stores, hotels and large commercial spaces.
  After-hours scheduling available.
- **Residential Cleaning** — Full home carpet care including move-in/move-out service.

## Frequently Asked Questions

**How do I get a free quote?**
Call or text (321) 315-8595, send a WhatsApp message, or fill out the form at
https://www.drxcleaning.com/contact.html. We respond within 1 hour during business hours.

**Do you offer same-day carpet cleaning in Orlando?**
Yes. Same-day and next-day appointments are available across Orlando and Central Florida,
subject to availability. Call early for the best chance at a same-day slot.

**Are your products safe for pets and children?**
Yes. All cleaning solutions are 100% eco-friendly, non-toxic and safe for pets, children
and allergy-sensitive individuals.

**How long does carpet cleaning take to dry?**
Carpets typically dry in 2–4 hours depending on humidity, airflow and carpet thickness.

**What is your satisfaction guarantee?**
If the client is not satisfied with the results, DRX returns and re-cleans the area at
no extra charge. No arguments, no hassle.

**What areas do you serve?**
Orlando, Windermere, Lake Nona, Dr. Phillips, Kissimmee, Oviedo, Winter Park,
Altamonte Springs, Sanford, Clermont, Celebration and surrounding Central Florida areas.
